Explore All 10 Services

Your software, your infrastructure and your day-to-day IT are one system. We treat them that way.

Ten services, one team: software and app development, websites, AI automation, cloud, cybersecurity, backup, managed IT, device setup, networks and equipment.

Start with one project or bring the whole picture. Either way you get a written scope before any work begins.

1

Software & App Development

Built around the work, not the workaround.

Custom software, web platforms, internal tools and integrations for Canadian organisations whose work does not fit an off-the-shelf product.

We build the system around your process: portals, dashboards, approval flows and integrations with the tools you keep. Our own engineers write the code and own the architecture.

Explore Software
2

Websites & Web Applications

A website that takes the booking, not just the compliment.

Fast, mobile-first websites and web applications: company sites, booking platforms, e-commerce and customer portals built to be found and to turn visitors into enquiries.

WordPress, Next.js or a fully custom build, chosen for the job. Accessibility-aware from the start so public-facing services meet WCAG expectations.

Explore Websites
3

AI Automation

Let the routine take care of itself.

Applied AI that removes repetitive work: assistants that answer from your own documents, automated reporting, document processing and workflow automation, with a human review step where it matters.

Built on commercial models such as OpenAI, Anthropic or Google, or on private, self-hosted models when data must stay in-house. Every automation is documented and reversible.

Explore AI Automation
4

Cloud Setup & Management

A good migration starts with a map.

Design, migration and management of cloud environments on Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, AWS, Azure or Linux servers, with monitoring, patching and cost control.

Migrations are planned in stages with a rollback at every step. Costs are reviewed so you pay for what you use.

Explore Cloud
5

Cybersecurity

Practical security for organisations that cannot afford a breach.

Security assessments, hardening, endpoint protection, access control, staff awareness and incident response planning, written into every project rather than bolted on.

We assess what you have, fix the gaps in priority order and document the policies so they survive staff changes.

Explore Security
6

Data Backup & Recovery

A plan you can explain to the board.

Automated, tested backups, local and cloud, with a documented recovery plan, so an outage or a ransomware event costs you minutes rather than days.

Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace are covered too: the platform keeps your service running, not your deleted mailbox.

Explore Backup
7

IT Support for Small Business

See the work. Not the tickets.

Managed IT for small and medium organisations: helpdesk, user management, software licensing and proactive maintenance on a fixed monthly plan.

We handle the everyday: new starters, leavers, licences, updates, printers and the vendors nobody wants to phone.

Explore IT Support
8

Computer & Laptop Setup

A little less back and forth.

Device provisioning, software installation, migration from old machines and ongoing troubleshooting for Windows and Mac, so new starters are productive on day one.

Old machines are migrated cleanly and wiped. Slow ones are diagnosed and tuned before anyone decides to replace them.

Explore Devices
9

Network & Wi-Fi Installation

Find your place on the network.

Wired and wireless networks for offices, retail and multi-building sites: site survey, design, installation, segmentation and monitoring.

We design for coverage and security first, install cleanly and document every port and device.

Explore Networks
10

IT Equipment Sales

Objects for everyday work.

Laptops, desktops, servers, networking gear, displays and peripherals from trusted vendors, right-sized for the job and installed and configured before handover.

We assess the need, quote transparently, procure, deliver and set up. Warranty and lifecycle are tracked so nothing surprises you.

Explore Equipment

How we work

Five Stages.
No Black Boxes.

01

Discover.

Understand the problem, constraints and users. We produce a written scope before anything is built.

  • Your goals and current setup
  • The people who will use it
  • Content, data and accounts we will need
02

Design.

Architecture, wireframes and a milestone plan, approved before build begins.

  • Written scope and staged pricing
  • Every screen designed before it is built
  • Fixed review points
03

Build.

Iterative development with regular demos, so you see progress throughout. Nothing disappears into a black box.

  • Regular working reviews
  • Testing against the agreed scope
  • Decisions logged as we go
04

Deploy.

Staged rollout, security review and performance testing before go-live.

  • Staged rollout with a rollback plan
  • Security and accessibility review
  • Performance testing on real devices
05

Support.

Documentation, training and an agreed support plan after go-live. Source code and accounts in your name.

  • Documentation, accounts and code handed over
  • Training for your team
  • Support and response times in writing

Three Questions Every
Client Asks First.

You get a written, itemised scope before work starts: stages, prices and assumptions in one document. Managed IT is a fixed monthly fee. No hourly surprises.

Most business websites go live in weeks, not months. Software and app builds are staged so you use the first release early, and you see working builds throughout.

Yes. Cloud regions, backups and self-hosted AI can all be kept in Canada, and the scope records where data is stored and processed.
